tldr: Mercury through the 7th house brings focus to partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others.
body: Mercury transiting the 7th house activates partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others. For a few weeks, thought, conversation, planning, and messages move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a thinking transit: it favors planning, conversations, edits, decisions, and information-gathering around the house topic.
business: Mercury supports relationship dynamics and agreements: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Overthinking, mixed messages, or handing your agency to someone else.
advice: Name the details in the 7th house deliberately. Work with partnerships, clients, contracts, and direct others without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
